title: pretty MELODÉ|Plus Size Glitter Ruffled High-Low Front Slit Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
This stunning high-low evening dress features glitter fabric that shimmers in the light, making you stand out at any event. The front side slit and ruffled V-neck add a touch of glamour and sophistication, creating a beautiful and elegant look.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
